entities.label: PRECEDENT

entities.text: High Court Of Madhya Pradesh, Bench At Indore
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Mr. Yogesh
Kumar Gupta, Counsel for the non- applicant/State.
Considered arguments made to some length on application for suspension of sentence.
The applicants have been inflicted with penalty by Adjudicating Officer under the Food and Safety Standards Act, 2006.
Counsel for the non-applicant/State has submitted that the applicants have not been sentenced to fine, but has been inflicted with penalty which cannot be suspended as 'penalty' is not 'sentenced'.
Counsel for the applicants submitted that he shall demonstrate that penalty which has been imposed upon the applicants was infact sentence.
He seeks time to argue the matter.
Let the matter be listed on 14.03.2019 as prayed for.

(SHAILENDRA SHUKLA) JUDGE Arun/-
